about: Hands-on care manuals for the Practice tab. Each step is our own plain wording of the cited pages, opened on their checkedAt date. A step's scene names the illustration the web app draws. The self-check questions repeat what the steps teach; they never assess the baby.

manuals.title: How to swaddle
manuals.summary: A snug wrap that leaves the hips free, in six folds.

steps.title: Lay the blanket out
steps.text: Spread a thin blanket flat like a diamond and fold the top corner down.

steps.title: Place the baby
steps.text: Lay your baby face up, with their shoulders just below the folded edge.

steps.title: First side
steps.text: Straighten the left arm, bring the left corner across the body and tuck it under the right arm.

steps.title: Second side
steps.text: Tuck the right arm down, then fold the right corner over the body and tuck it under the left side.

steps.title: Bottom, loosely
steps.text: Fold or twist the bottom loosely and tuck it under one side, so the legs can bend up and out.
steps.watch: Legs held straight and wrapped tight can harm the hips. Keep the bottom roomy.

steps.title: Check the fit
steps.text: Slide two or three fingers between the chest and the blanket. The hips should move freely.
steps.watch: Stop swaddling as soon as your baby shows any sign of trying to roll over. Some start around 2 months.

check.prompt: How should the legs sit in a swaddle?

choices.text: Free to bend up and out
Two or three fingers fit underneath
As tight as it will go
As soon as baby tries to roll

manuals.title: How to burp
manuals.summary: Three holds to try, and when to reach for them.

steps.title: When to burp
steps.text: Pause every 60 to 90 mL from a bottle, or when you switch breasts, and always once the feed is done.

steps.title: Hold 1: over the shoulder
steps.text: Hold your baby upright, chin resting on your shoulder, one hand under them. Pat the back with the other.

steps.title: Hold 2: sitting on your lap
steps.text: Sit your baby on your knee, cradle the chin in your palm with the heel of your hand on the chest, and pat the back.
steps.watch: Hold the chin, not the throat.

steps.title: Hold 3: belly down
steps.text: Lay your baby tummy down across your lap with the head higher than the chest, and pat the back gently.

steps.title: No burp? Switch
steps.text: If nothing comes after a few minutes, change holds and try again, then carry on feeding. Keep baby upright 10 to 15 minutes after.

check.prompt: Bottle feeding: when do you pause to burp?

choices.text: Only when the bottle is empty

check.prompt: Sitting hold: where does your hand go?

manuals.title: Set up safe sleep
manuals.summary: Back to sleep, a bare firm crib, close to you.

steps.title: Firm and flat
steps.text: Use a crib, bassinet or play yard with a firm, flat, level mattress and only a fitted sheet.
steps.watch: Sofas, armchairs and memory foam are not safe places for a baby to sleep.

steps.title: Nothing else in it
steps.text: Take out pillows, blankets, soft toys and bumpers. A bare crib is the safest one.

steps.title: On the back, feet to foot
steps.text: Lay your baby on their back for every sleep, with their feet at the bottom of the crib.
steps.watch: If they roll before they can roll both ways, turn them back onto their back.

steps.title: In your room
steps.text: Keep the crib in your room, near your bed, for every sleep for at least the first 6 months.

choices.text: A soft blanket and a toy

check.prompt: Where does the crib go for the first 6 months?
